kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the facts; the pattern/trap/pivot attack structure is a KYP design that does not exist in the source.
kypExtensions.summary: KYP-authored exam-strategy synthesis (pedigree-mode stems, the three-question tree, the 2/3-vs-1/2 carrier trap, Leber mini-case with answer autopsy).

kypExtensions.rationale: The three-question reading order (male-to-male? affected father's children? mother-only?) is a KYP-original decision tree; First Aid prints the five rules side by side but not the reading algorithm.
kypExtensions.summary: The decision-tree sort of the five modes plus the two-absolute-father-rules frame ('no affected father ever passes XLR to a son; XLD father hits every daughter and no son').
